summary: Scene, music and CI are merged. Integration (WP5) is running: wiring everything into the APK and testing on an Android 7.0 emulator.

packages.title: Device survey
packages.note: Needs the bike connected over adb. Not connected yet.

packages.title: Monorepo scaffold
packages.note: Gradle monorepo, convention plugins, placeholder cube app. Debug and release APKs build; check passes.

packages.title: CI and releases
packages.note: CI builds every app on each push; main refreshes a rolling 'latest' release; tags like roadwork-v0.1.0 make releases. Debug-signed until the signing secrets are added.

packages.title: Roadwork scene
packages.note: Procedural dawn waterfront, original coach on a town bike with pedalling and waves, HUD with pace, music and settings. 26 tests; 19 draw calls and about 14k triangles per frame.

packages.title: Music library
packages.note: Folder music player on Media3 1.11.1 with shuffle, in-app folder browser and settings screen. 21 unit tests plus 3 tests passing on an Android 7.0 emulator.

packages.title: Integration and device pass
packages.note: Agent wiring scene, music and settings into the Android app and testing on an Android 7.0 emulator.

packages.title: Bike cadence as pace
packages.note: Research done (docs/BIKE_SENSORS.md): a Peloton system service exposes cadence, power and resistance to sideloaded apps on newer firmware. Unconfirmed on Android 7.0; needs read-only adb checks on the bike before any code.

log.text: Repo public, plan committed, progress site added.
WP1 scaffold agent and WP6 research agent started.
WP6 research finished: likely route via a Peloton sensor service, to be confirmed on the bike.

Shared interfaces module (libs/api) added. Wave 2 started: WP2, WP3, WP4 in parallel.
Screenshots now captured live on each push by the progress site build.
WP2 CI merged. First real CI run on GitHub starting.
WP4 music library merged. Note: FLAC will not play on Android 7.0; use ogg or mp3.
WP3 scene merged. Screenshots above are captured from each build.
